103	    def __init__(self) -> None:
104	        self._collections: MutableMapping[str, str] = {}

106	    def transform(self, cfn: Any) -> TransformResult:
107	        """Transform the template"""
108	        return [], self._walk(cfn.template, {}, cfn)
109	
110	    # pylint: disable=too-many-return-statements
111	    def _walk(self, item: Any, params: MutableMapping[str, Any], cfn: Any):
112	        obj = deepcopy(item)
113	        if isinstance(obj, dict):
114	            # adjust keys if needed
115	            if params:
116	                for k, v in item.items():
117	                    _, new_k = self._replace_string_params(k, params)
118	                    if new_k != k:
119	                        del obj[k]
120	                        obj[new_k] = v
121	
122	            for k, v in deepcopy(obj).items():
123	                # see if key matches Fn::ForEach
124	                if re.match(FUNCTION_FOR_EACH, k):
125	                    # only translate the foreach if its valid
126	                    foreach = _ForEach(k, v, self._collections)
127	                    # get the values will flatten the foreach
128	                    for collection_value in foreach.items(cfn, params):
129	                        flattened = self._walk(
130	                            v[2], {**params, **{v[0]: collection_value}}, cfn
131	                        )
132	                        for f_k, f_v in flattened.items():
133	                            if f_k not in obj:
134	                                obj[f_k] = f_v
135	                            else:
136	                                raise _ValueError(
137	                                    f"Duplicate {f_k} while doing transformation",
138	                                    f_k,
139	                                )
140	                    del obj[k]
141	                elif k == "Fn::ToJsonString":
142	                    # extra special handing for this as {} could be a valid value
143	                    return obj
144	                elif k == "Fn::GetAtt":
145	                    if isinstance(v, (list, str)):
146	                        obj[k] = self._walk(v, params, cfn)
147	                elif k == "Fn::Sub":
148	                    if isinstance(v, str):
149	                        only_string, obj[k] = self._replace_string_params(v, params)
150	                        if only_string:

152	                    if isinstance(v, list):
153	                        only_string, obj[k][0] = self._replace_string_params(

172	                    for i, el in enumerate(v):

200	    def _replace_string_params(
201	        self,
202	        s: str,
203	        params: Mapping[str, Any],
204	    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
205	        pattern = r"(\$|&){[a-zA-Z0-9\.:]+}"
206	        if not re.search(pattern, s):
207	            return (True, s)
208	
209	        new_s = deepcopy(s)
210	        for k, v in params.items():
211	            if isinstance(v, dict):
212	                v = (
213	                    hashlib.md5(json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8"), usedforsecurity=False)
214	                    .digest()
215	                    .hex()[0:4]
216	                )
217	            new_s = re.sub(rf"\$\{{{k}\}}", v, new_s)
218	            new_s = re.sub(rf"\&\{{{k}\}}", re.sub("[^0-9a-zA-Z]+", "", v), new_s)
219	
220	        if isinstance(s, str_node):
221	            new_s = str_node(new_s, s.start_mark, s.end_mark)
222	
223	        return (not (bool(re.search(pattern, new_s))), new_s)

I wrote the answer to `answer.json`. It comes from reading `_walk` in `src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_language_extensions.py` and tracing the test by hand, since nothing can be run here.

The outermost `_walk` returns:
- **`Mappings`:** unchanged.
- **`Resources`:** the `Fn::ForEach::Items` key is removed. In its place are `ServerA` then `ServerB`, each with `Type: AWS::EC2::Instance`.

For each server, with `X` standing for A or B, the properties become:

| Property | Result |
|---|---|
| `Tag` | `"tag-${Letter}"`, unchanged, because `${Letter}` in a plain string value isn't substituted |
| `Name` | `"srv-X"` |
| `Subnet` | `"X"` |
| `Index` | `{"Ref": "Region"}`, unchanged, because `Region` isn't a loop variable |
| `Description` | `{"Fn::Sub": ["shared-X-${X}", {"X": "extra"}]}`. `${X}` is still unresolved, so the dict is kept and its second element is walked but doesn't change. |
| `GetMap` | `"111"` for A, `"222"` for B |
| `GetMissing` | `{"Fn::FindInMap": ["M1", "X", "absent"]}` |

`GetMissing` stays a `FindInMap` because the lookup finds no `absent` key and raises an error. `_walk` catches it and walks each list element, so only the `{"Ref": "Letter"}` inside becomes the loop value.
